title: dHolograms
description: A lightweight, feature-rich hologram plugin for Paper 1.21+
body:
Plain Text Description & Features **dHolograms**
──────────────────────────────────────────────
dHolograms is a lightweight, feature-rich hologram plugin for Paper 1.21+ built entirely on native TextDisplay and ItemDisplay entities. No armor stands, no packet tricks - just clean modern display entities that look great at any render distance. Supports MiniMessage formatting, 5 text animations, multi-page navigation, interactive click actions, per-player placeholders, and both YML and MySQL storage. **FEATURES**
──────────────────────────────────────────────
MiniMessage Formatting Full Adventure MiniMessage support in every text line. Gradients, hex colors, bold, italic, rainbow, and any decoration tag you can write - rendered natively. 5 Text Animations Server-side animations that tick every game tick. Each type is fully configurable with speed, and Wave and Burn support custom color pairs. Types: Rainbow, Wave, Burn, Typewriter, Scroll. Click Actions Assign chainable action pipelines to right, left, shift-right, and shift-left clicks. Permission gates, messages, commands, teleport, BungeeCord, and page navigation. 9 action types total. Multi-Page Holograms Stack content across pages with per-player tracking. Navigation arrows are automatically spawned and despawned. Jump to specific pages via click actions. Item Display Lines True 3D ItemDisplay entities - no billboarded sprites. Configurable Y-axis rotation speed and vertical bobbing amplitude. Mix freely with text lines. PlaceholderAPI Any PAPI placeholder resolves per-player - each viewer sees their own values. Configurable refresh interval and a separate update range to save CPU at distance.
